import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a countplot of transaction types for fraudulent and non-fraudulent transactions
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=data)
plt.title('Transaction Types for Fraudulent and Non-Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type Status')
plt.tight_layout()
